feature.videoApi: Video API is disabled. Enable it under Admin → API features → Videos API.
feature.audioApi: Audio API is disabled. Enable it under Admin → API features → Audio API.
feature.tools: Tools are disabled. Enable Tools under Admin → API features (required for image generation).
feature.filesOpenAiAlias: OpenAI Files API alias is disabled. Enable it under Admin → API features → Files API alias.

media.agent_or_admin_required: Image generation requires an agent-mode API key or an admin session. Safe-mode keys cannot use image tools.
media.source_required: Provide an image file, a media asset, or a document as the source.
media.source_must_be_image: The selected source must be an image for edit or video generation.
media.no_image_in_sandbox: Generation finished but no image file was found. This is not an imagesApi or API-key problem.
media.no_video_in_sandbox: Generation finished but no video file was found.
media.provider_no_edit: The current media provider does not support image edits.
